caption:
This tabletop edge was cut from one solid board. Wood grain is the same material all the way through, so it carries over every edge without a break. A veneer or laminate face is a thin skin glued on top, and the pattern stops at the cut or repeats in a way real grain never does. Check a table edge or an open drawer side before you buy. Send this to whoever's about to buy furniture labelled "solid wood."
